report.root_cause: Player ShadowPhantom99 systematically broke an oak_planks wall at x8-14, y-60..-56, z8 in the overworld (seen in plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv). Mira_Crafts was placing cobblestone at around x-22..-17, z20-21 during the same period. I judged that to be her own building and did not act on it.
report.actions: Checked status and logs, which were normal at first. Saw the BlockLog entries showing ShadowPhantom99 breaking the planks wall. Declared the incident and banned ShadowPhantom99. Restored the wall with three fill commands (oak_planks, replace air) over the broken coordinates. This also covers any cells at x=11, y=-60/-59 that were already air before the grief, since the fill couldn't tell them apart. Watched afterward: TPS 20, no further grief, 3 players online. I did not re-check the BlockLog after the ban and did not look at the restored wall.
report.residual_risk: The server runs in offline mode, so a banned user can rejoin under another name. The wall restore was done by command and not verified. The two blocks at x=11, y=-60/-59 may have been non-planks or air before, and I may have filled them. I didn't check whether ShadowPhantom99 damaged anything else, and the BlockLog showed no other victims. The game-mode and teleport RCON commands on the two players came from outside my actions and I didn't investigate them.
